principle: hard gates are evaluated before quality scores; no aesthetic, usability, or craft score can compensate for a failed applicable authority, safety, accessibility, security/privacy, AI-agency, modality, evidence, or research-validity gate

authority-preservation.pass: explicit product/safety/accepted-target constraints and higher-authority standards/guidance are preserved or conflicts are surfaced
authority-preservation.fail: the design silently overrides a material requirement or lowers authority because another option looks better

mandatory-route-coverage.pass: deterministic profile predicates have no missing owner or verifier route
mandatory-route-coverage.fail: a material platform, modality, AI role, risk, temporal or specialist decision class is unowned or its required critic is omitted

no-self-certification.pass: material completion uses independent critic/evidence and a bounded gate
no-self-certification.fail: the generator's confidence, code compilation, or self-review is the sole proof

unknown-not-pass.pass: missing capability/evidence narrows the claim or remains UNKNOWN/BLOCKED
unknown-not-pass.fail: unexecuted browser/device/a11y/safety/fidelity/research checks are assumed to have passed

human-factors-and-safety.pass: when consequence warrants it, task/environment/error/workload/recovery evidence and independent safety critique are present
human-factors-and-safety.fail: a high-risk interface is released from visual/usability evidence alone

accessibility-reachability.pass: applicable semantics, focus, modality alternatives, perception, communication, settings bootstrap, media alternatives and specialist obligations are evidenced
accessibility-reachability.fail: an applicable user/access channel is unreachable or compliance is inferred from a partial automated score

security-and-privacy.pass: sensitive data, identity, consent, permissions, target binding and privacy boundaries are explicit when applicable
security-and-privacy.fail: visual convenience or personalization silently expands data/action authority

ai-agency.pass: AI identity, uncertainty/provenance, action scope, reversibility, correction and attribution are explicit when material
ai-agency.fail: generated or inferred content/action gains more authority than the evidence or user authorization permits

modality-reachability.pass: critical operations remain reachable across applicable modalities with correct focus/target/feedback and alternative paths
modality-reachability.fail: a preferred gesture/device path removes necessary keyboard, remote, touch, voice, alternative-input or other applicable access

state-and-resilience.pass: material interaction, validation, async, permission, error, offline, realtime and degraded states are accounted for
state-and-resilience.fail: known consequential states are replaced by nominal screenshots or happy-path assumptions

fidelity-evidence.pass: strict fidelity claims compare authoritative target with inspectable current render for claimed states/viewports
fidelity-evidence.fail: memory, source code, stale images or an unrelated render substitute for comparison

research-authority-and-freshness.pass: research-sensitive claims identify source authority/status/freshness and drafts remain drafts
research-authority-and-freshness.fail: model memory or a stale/draft source is promoted into an unsupported current normative claim

bounded-saturation.pass: a SATURATED research claim has five PASS dimensions, zero-novelty final sweep evidence, explicit bounds and reopen conditions
bounded-saturation.fail: research completeness is declared because many sources were read or the catalogue is large

quality_scale.1: major failure; plausible output hides broken reasoning
quality_scale.3: competent for the scoped task; important tradeoffs addressed
quality_scale.4: strong, deliberate, coherent and resilient with minor gaps
quality_scale.5: exceptional for the task; decisions are specific, integrated, evidenced and difficult to improve without a real tradeoff

quality_dimensions.product-and-task-fit: hierarchy and behavior derive from actual product objects, user jobs, frequency, environment, trust and consequence
quality_dimensions.human-factors-fit: attention, cognitive load, memory, perception, motor control, fatigue and error recovery match operating conditions
quality_dimensions.information-architecture: grouping, labels, hierarchy, navigation and comparison relationships form a learnable scalable model
quality_dimensions.interaction-quality: affordance, modality, target, focus, state, feedback, async behavior and recovery are coherent
quality_dimensions.visual-hierarchy: composition, typography, color, spacing, surfaces, media and attention order reinforce task priority
quality_dimensions.aesthetic-specificity: visual direction is rooted in subject/brand/context rather than interchangeable category defaults
quality_dimensions.system-coherence: tokens, components, variants, state semantics and governance remain reusable without one-off drift
quality_dimensions.platform-and-device-fit: the UI is native to surface geometry, viewing distance, physical constraints and platform conventions without losing product semantics
quality_dimensions.inclusive-design-depth: applicable accessibility, communication, localization, RTL, media, settings and assistive-input needs are integrated rather than appended
quality_dimensions.ai-and-trust-quality: AI behavior, provenance, agency, correction, identity and uncertainty preserve user control and calibrate trust
quality_dimensions.temporal-resilience: latency, streaming, realtime, offline, interruption, long-running work and conflicts remain truthful and recoverable
quality_dimensions.content-and-assistance: labels, errors, status, guidance, help and terminology support prediction and recovery without masking weak UI
quality_dimensions.evidence-quality: claims are supported by the right authority and fresh task-specific evidence, with uncertainty and bounds explicit

release_rule: all applicable hard gates must PASS; quality scoring may guide refinement but cannot close a failed hard gate
